notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty.heading: Emails to applicants and buyers
notifications.empty.body: Edit the emails Tradepass sends and choose which alerts you receive.
notifications.quota.heading: Today's email limit
notifications.quota.store: {used} of {cap} emails used today. {left, plural, one {# email left.} other {# emails left.}}
notifications.quota.explain: To keep Tradepass free, each store can send up to {storeCap} emails a day, and all stores together up to {globalCap}. The count resets at midnight UTC. If the limit is reached, emails wait in a queue and go out the next day. Nothing is lost.
notifications.quota.flow: Prefer your own email tool? Turn any email off below and use Shopify Flow instead.
notifications.quota.deferredHeading: {count, plural, one {# email is waiting for tomorrow} other {# emails are waiting for tomorrow}}
notifications.quota.deferredBody: Today's email limit was reached, so these emails will be sent automatically on the next day with room. You don't need to do anything.
notifications.merchant.heading: Alerts for you
notifications.merchant.mode.instant: Email me for each new application
notifications.merchant.mode.instant.help: You'll get an email for each new application. These count toward your store's daily limit; when it's reached, new applications appear in the next daily summary instead. You also get the daily summary of expiring certificates and failed actions.
notifications.merchant.mode.digest.help: One email each morning (UTC) with pending applications, expiring certificates and failed actions. Sent only when there's something to report.
notifications.merchant.mode.off.help: Tradepass won't email you. Check Home for pending work.
notifications.merchant.emailHelp: Leave empty to use your store's contact email ({email}).
notifications.emails.heading: Emails to applicants and buyers
notifications.emails.intro: Each email is sent in the applicant's language. Edit the text for one language at a time. Leave a field empty to go back to the built-in text.
notifications.language.label: Language you're editing
notifications.language.help: Emails in other languages keep their own text. If a language has no text, the store's main language is used.
notifications.welcome.label: Use Shopify's B2B welcome email for approvals
notifications.welcome.help: Shopify's own email invites the buyer to sign in. Tradepass's Approved email below is then sent only if Shopify's email can't be sent.
notifications.type.received.help: Sent right after someone submits the application form.
notifications.type.needs_info.help: Sent when you ask for more information. Includes a secure link to update the application.
notifications.type.approved.help: Welcome email with how to sign in with a one-time code.
notifications.type.rejected.help: Sent when you don't approve an application. Your reason is added if you give one.
notifications.type.cert_expiring.help: Sent 30 and 7 days before a certificate expires, with a secure upload link.
notifications.type.cert_expired.help: Sent once when a certificate expires, with a secure upload link.
notifications.email.subject: Subject
notifications.email.bodyHelp: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Links are made clickable automatically.
notifications.email.placeholdersHelp: Type a placeholder with its curly brackets. It's replaced with the real value when the email is sent.
notifications.preview.heading: Preview
notifications.preview.subject: Subject: {subject}
notifications.preview.invalid: The preview will appear once every placeholder is complete, for example '{company}'.
notifications.test.deferred: Today's limit is reached. The test email to {email} will be sent tomorrow.
notifications.test.failed: We couldn't send the test email. Check that your account has an email address.
notifications.error.summary: {count, plural, one {Fix # field before saving} other {Fix # fields before saving}}
notifications.error.syntax: This text has an unmatched curly bracket. Check that each placeholder looks like '{company}'.
notifications.error.placeholder: {name} isn't a placeholder this email can fill. Use one from the list below.
notifications.error.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
notifications.field.subject: Subject of the {email} email
